def remove_nums(text):
    nonums = re.sub('[^\u4e00-\u9fa5]+', '', text)
    return nonums
test = df['作文标题'][8]
remove_nums(test)

In [4]:
# 加载中文停用词词典，可个性化设置
stopwords = open('stopwords.txt', encoding = 'utf-8').read()

def clean_text(text):
    words = jieba.lcut(text)
    words = [w for w in words if w not in stopwords]
    return ' '.join(words)
test = df['作文标题'][8]
clean_text(test)

wordcloud = WordCloud(
    font_path='/System/Library/Fonts/PingFang.ttc',  # 指定中文字体文件路径
    background_color='white',  # 设置背景颜色
    width=800,
    height=600,
    max_words=300,  # 设置最大显示的词数
    max_font_size=100  # 设置字体最大值
).generate_from_frequencies(word_freq)

# 显示词云图

plt.axis('off')
plt.savefig('wordcloud_全部作文标题.png', dpi=300)
plt.show()

In [14]:
#训练词嵌入模型
from gensim.models import Word2Vec
corpus=df['作文标题分词'].apply(lambda X: X.split()).tolist()#切分词语
model=Word2Vec(
    corpus, #训练语料
    window=5,#训练算法考虑的当前词语与预测词语在一个句子中的最大距离（窗口大小）
    vector_size=300,#自定义训练向量维度
    min_count=1,#忽略所有总频数低于这个值的词语
    #workers=4,#用于训练的线程数
    epochs=5)#迭代

#保存训练好的模型
model.save('word2vec_全部作文标题.model')

#检查嵌入模型中任意两个词向量的余弦相似度，即语义接近性
#余弦相似度的取值介于[-1，1]之间，-1表示语义完全相反，1表示语义完全相同，0表示毫无关系
#model.sv.similarity这个函数与np.dot(vector1,vector2)/(np.linalg.norm(vector1)*np.linalg.norm(vector2))输出的结果一样
print(model.wv.similarity('朋友', '放风筝'))
print(model.wv.similarity('学会', '放风筝'))
print(model.wv.similarity('心愿', '放风筝'))
print(model.wv.similarity('朋友', '学会'))
print(model.wv.similarity('朋友', '心愿'))
print(model.wv.similarity('学会', '心愿'))

# 可视化

words = ['朋友', '放风筝', '学会', '心愿','探险','研究','报告']
vectors = [model.wv[word] for word in words]

from sklearn.decomposition import PCA     # 语义空间降维，用于展示词语在二维空间的相对位置

# 使用PCA进行降维
pca = PCA(n_components = 2)
pca_result = pca.fit_transform(vectors)

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt     # 画图

# 绘制四个词语在二维空间的相对位置
plt.rcParams['font.sans-serif'] = ['Arial Unicode MS']
plt.rcParams['axes.unicode_minus'] = False
plt.figure()

# 取PCA降维结果中所有行的第一列和第二列数据绘制散点图，设置点的大小为50
plt.scatter(pca_result[:, 0], pca_result[:, 1], s = 50)

for i, word in enumerate(words):
    plt.annotate(word, (pca_result[i, 0], pca_result[i, 1]), fontsize = 15)

plt.xlabel('PCA维度1', fontsize = 20)
plt.ylabel('PCA维度2', fontsize = 20)
plt.title('二维语义空间中词语的分布', fontsize = 20)
plt.grid(True)
plt.show()

word_grade = {}

    if word in common_words:
        word_grade[word] = 0  # 共有词

        word_grade[word] = 3
    elif word in grade4_words:
        word_grade[word] = 4
    elif word in grade5_words:
        word_grade[word] = 5
    elif word in grade6_words:
        word_grade[word] = 6
    else:
        word_grade[word] = -1  # 未分类

# 打印词汇年级分布统计
print("\n词汇年级分布统计:")
grade_counts = {3: 0, 4: 0, 5: 0, 6: 0, 0: 0, -1: 0}
for word in words_to_visualize:
    grade_counts[word_grade[word]] += 1

grade_names = {3: '三年级', 4: '四年级', 5: '五年级', 6: '六年级', 0: '共有词', -1: '未分类'}
for grade, count in grade_counts.items():
    if count > 0:
        print(f"  {grade_names[grade]}: {count} 个")

# ============================================
# 5. 提取词向量
# ============================================

vectors = []
valid_words = []
missing_words = []

for word in words_to_visualize:
    try:
        vec = model.wv[word]
        vectors.append(vec)
        valid_words.append(word)
    except KeyError:
        missing_words.append(word)

vectors = np.array(vectors)
print(f"\n成功提取 {len(valid_words)} 个词的向量")
print(f"缺失 {len(missing_words)} 个词")

if missing_words:
    print("\n缺失的词汇（不在模型中）:")
    for i, word in enumerate(missing_words[:20]):
        print(f"  {word}", end=' ')
        if (i+1) % 10 == 0:
            print()
    if len(missing_words) > 20:
        print(f"\n  ... 还有 {len(missing_words)-20} 个词")

if len(vectors) < 2:
    print("错误：有效词汇不足2个，无法进行PCA分析")
    exit()

成功提取 182 个词的向量
缺失 0 个词

pca_result = pca.fit_transform(vectors)

print(f"累计解释方差: {pca.explained_variance_ratio_.sum():.2%}")

# ============================================
# 7. 可视化（按年级分颜色）
# ============================================

pca_result[:, 0] = -pca_result[:, 0]  # PC1坐标取反

# 设置颜色映射
grade_colors = {
    3: '#FF69B4',   # 粉色 - 三年级
    4: '#32CD32',   # 绿色 - 四年级
    5: '#FF4444',   # 红色 - 五年级
    6: '#FFD700',   # 黄色 - 六年级
    0: '#888888',   # 灰色 - 共有词
    -1: '#000000'   # 黑色 - 未分类
}

# 设置字体（根据您的系统选择合适的字体）
plt.rcParams['font.sans-serif'] = ['Arial Unicode MS', 'SimHei', 'PingFang SC', 'Heiti SC']
plt.rcParams['axes.unicode_minus'] = False

# 创建图形（增大尺寸以容纳更多词汇）
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(16, 14))

# 按年级分组绘制
for grade in [3, 4, 5, 6, 0, -1]:
    grade_words = [w for w in valid_words if word_grade[w] == grade]
    if not grade_words:
        continue
    
    # 获取这些词在PCA结果中的索引
    grade_indices = [valid_words.index(w) for w in grade_words]
    x = pca_result[grade_indices, 0]
    y = pca_result[grade_indices, 1]
    
    # 根据年级设置点的大小
    if grade == 0:
        size = 120
        alpha = 0.7
    elif grade == -1:
        size = 100
        alpha = 0.6
    else:
        size = 140
        alpha = 0.85
    
    # 绘制散点
    ax.scatter(x, y, c=grade_colors[grade], s=size, alpha=alpha, 
               edgecolors='white', linewidth=1.5, 
               label=grade_names[grade])
    
    # 添加标签
    for word, xi, yi in zip(grade_words, x, y):
        # 根据年级设置标签字体大小
        if grade == 0:
            fontsize = 11
            fontweight = 'normal'
        elif grade == -1:
            fontsize = 10
            fontweight = 'normal'
        else:
            fontsize = 13
            fontweight = 'normal'
        
        # 添加背景框让标签更清晰
        bbox_props = dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.2', facecolor='white', 
                         alpha=0.7, edgecolor='none')
        ax.annotate(word, (xi, yi), fontsize=fontsize, fontweight=fontweight,
                   ha='center', va='bottom', xytext=(0, 3), textcoords='offset points',
                   bbox=bbox_props)

# 添加图例
legend_elements = [
    Patch(facecolor='#FF69B4', label='三年级', alpha=0.85),
    Patch(facecolor='#32CD32', label='四年级', alpha=0.85),
    Patch(facecolor='#FF4444', label='五年级', alpha=0.85),
    Patch(facecolor='#FFD700', label='六年级', alpha=0.85),
    Patch(facecolor='#888888', label='共有词', alpha=0.7)
]
ax.legend(handles=legend_elements, loc='upper right', fontsize=16, framealpha=0.9)

# 设置坐标轴标签和标题
ax.set_xlabel(f'PCA维度1 ({pca.explained_variance_ratio_[0]:.1%})', fontsize=18)
ax.set_ylabel(f'PCA维度2 ({pca.explained_variance_ratio_[1]:.1%})', fontsize=18)
ax.set_title('小学3-6年级作文关键词在语义空间的分布\n（基于Word2Vec词向量，按年级分色）', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold')

# 添加网格
ax.grid(True, alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')

# 调整坐标轴范围，让点不要太靠边
x_margin = (pca_result[:, 0].max() - pca_result[:, 0].min()) * 0.05
y_margin = (pca_result[:, 1].max() - pca_result[:, 1].min()) * 0.05
ax.set_xlim(pca_result[:, 0].min() - x_margin, pca_result[:, 0].max() + x_margin)
ax.set_ylim(pca_result[:, 1].min() - y_margin, pca_result[:, 1].max() + y_margin)

# 进一步紧凑布局，减少四周留白
plt.subplots_adjust(left=0.08, right=0.95, top=0.93, bottom=0.07)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('words_pca_by_grade_all.png', dpi=600, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.show()

print("\n已保存: words_pca_by_grade_all.png")

# 8. 显示各年级中心点
# ============================================

print("\n各年级中心点坐标:")
grade_centers = {}
for grade in [3, 4, 5, 6]:
    grade_words = [w for w in valid_words if word_grade[w] == grade]
    if grade_words:
        grade_indices = [valid_words.index(w) for w in grade_words]
        center = pca_result[grade_indices].mean(axis=0)
        grade_centers[grade] = center
        print(f"  {grade_names[grade]}: ({center[0]:.3f}, {center[1]:.3f})")

# 如果有共有词，也显示其中心点
common_words_list = [w for w in valid_words if word_grade[w] == 0]
if common_words_list:
    common_indices = [valid_words.index(w) for w in common_words_list]
    common_center = pca_result[common_indices].mean(axis=0)
    print(f"  共有词: ({common_center[0]:.3f}, {common_center[1]:.3f})")

#计算困惑度
def perplexity(num_topics):
    ldamodel = LdaModel(corpus, num_topics=num_topics, id2word = dictionary, passes=30)
    print(ldamodel.print_topics(num_topics=num_topics, num_words=15))
    print(ldamodel.log_perplexity(corpus))
    return ldamodel.log_perplexity(corpus)
In [26]:
#计算coherence
def coherence(num_topics):
    ldamodel = LdaModel(corpus, num_topics=num_topics, id2word = dictionary, passes=30,random_state = 1)
    print(ldamodel.print_topics(num_topics=num_topics, num_words=10))
    ldacm = CoherenceModel(model=ldamodel, texts=txt, dictionary=dictionary, coherence='c_v')
    print(ldacm.get_coherence())
    return ldacm.get_coherence()

result_list =[]
for i in lda.get_document_topics(corpus)[:]:
    listj=[]
    for j in i:
        listj.append(j[1])
    bz=listj.index(max(listj))
    result_list.append(i[bz][0])
print(result_list[:20])
